review_candidates.title: Junior Support Engineer

matched_queries.query: Middle East and Africa IT support

review_candidates.description: We ontwerpen en implementeren ICT, telecom en audiovisuele oplossingen. Dit omvat zowel software als hardware. Onze oplossingen zijn altijd in co-creatie met onze klanten. We inspireren hen graag met innovatieve technologieën, net zoveel als wij er zelf door ge nspireerd worden. Axians is een merk van VINCI Energies. Als Groep hebben we de mogelijkheid om creatieve oplossingen te ontwerpen en slimme aanbiedingen te ontwikkelen, waarbij we een beroep kunnen doen op de expertise van andere merken van VINCI Energies wanneer nodig. Ons gedecentraliseerd model stelt onze mensen in staat om innovatie op lokaal niveau te ontwikkelen, waardoor producten ontstaan die vervolgens op grotere schaal kunnen worden ingezet. Bij Axians geloven we dat technologie pas écht het verschil maakt wanneer mensen vlot kunnen samenwerken. Achter elke goed werkende tool zitten enthousiaste collega's die gebruikers ondersteunen, problemen oplossen en continu blijven bijleren. Ben jij gebeten door IT? Help je graag mensen verder? En wil je je carrière starten in een omgeving waar je elke dag kan bijleren? Dan hebben wij de uitdaging voor jou. Als Junior Support Engineer maak je deel uit van ons interne IT-team en word je ondergedompeld in het Atlassian-landschap. Via binnenkomende supportvragen en tickets leer je stap voor stap hoe onze applicaties werken en hoe je gebruikers zo goed mogelijk ondersteunt. Je hoeft nog geen expert te zijn. Die expertise bouw je samen met ons op. Jouw uitdaging Geen enkele dag is dezelfde. Jij bent het aanspreekpunt voor collega's die ondersteuning nodig hebben en krijgt de kans om je technische kennis elke dag verder uit te breiden. Je zal onder andere: Binnenkomende supporttickets analyseren en oplossen. Collega's ondersteunen bij vragen rond onze interne applicaties. Gebruikers begeleiden wanneer iets niet werkt zoals verwacht. Kennis opbouwen binnen het Atlassian-ecosysteem, met tools zoals Jira en Confluence. Samenwerken met ervaren collega's om complexere issues op te lossen. Meewerken aan het verbeteren van onze interne dienstverlening. Oplossingen documenteren zodat kennis binnen het team gedeeld wordt. Mee nadenken over hoe processen en tools nog gebruiksvriendelijker kunnen worden. Kortom: je leert onze applicaties van binnen en van buiten kennen en groeit uit tot een echte specialist. Wie ben jij? Je hoeft niet alles al te kennen. We zoeken vooral iemand met goesting om te leren. Daarnaast herken je jezelf in het volgende: Je hebt een bachelor of master in economie, bedrijfskunde of IT-gerelateerde richting gevolg. Een combinatie van beide domeinen is een plus! Of je hebt een eerste ervaring binnen IT support en wil je verder ontwikkelen. Je bent nieuwsgierig en leert graag nieuwe technologieën kennen. Je haalt voldoening uit het helpen van anderen. Je denkt oplossingsgericht en houdt van technische uitdagingen. Je bent communicatief en klantgericht. Je spreekt vlot Nederlands en kan je goed uitdrukken in het Engels. Kennis van Jira of Confluence? Mooi meegenomen. Nog geen ervaring? Geen probleem, wij leren het je graag. Waarom kiezen voor Axians? Omdat je hier niet zomaar een job krijgt, maar een plek waar je kan groeien. Je komt terecht in een enthousiast team dat je begeleidt, ondersteunt en uitdaagt om het beste uit jezelf te halen. Wat mag je verwachten? Een ideale startersfunctie binnen IT. Intensieve begeleiding door ervaren collega's. Volop kansen om opleidingen en certificeringen te volgen. Een omgeving waar vragen stellen wordt aangemoedigd. Een gevarieerde job waarin je elke dag iets nieuws leert. Flexibele werkuren en hybride werken. Een aantrekkelijk loonpakket met heel wat extralegale voordelen. Een warme bedrijfscultuur waar samenwerking centraal staat. Klaar om je IT-carrière te lanceren? Wil jij uitgroeien tot dé expert achter onze Atlassian-omgeving en collega's elke dag ondersteunen met een glimlach? Dan kijken we ernaar uit om jou te ontmoeten. The best of ICT with a human touch. Important note Please be advised that a valid work permit for Belgium is required for non-EU citizens. Unfortunately, applications without a valid work permit and sufficient language skills may not be considered. LNKD1_BE

About The Role Client-facing products and AI-enabled services don't stop at being built. Someone has to implement them with the client, run them reliably, fix what breaks and keep improving them. That's this role. You'll be given an outcome – a major sports client's product roadmap, a new client-facing product, an AI-enabled service that has to run every day – and you'll own it end to end: plan, people, delivery, operation, improvement. You'll work across clients, Product, Engineering, Design and Support, and you'll direct a small number of more junior team members. You're not writing the core product code. You are expected to understand the product and its environment well enough to investigate problems yourself, make sound delivery decisions and explain trade-offs to a client without hiding behind internal complexity. What You'll Do Take products and initiatives from an ambiguous brief through configuration, onboarding, testing, rollout and adoption to reliable day-to-day operation. Turn messy requests into a plan with owners, dependencies, risks and a definition of done — then run it: brief people, follow up, remove blockers, make the calls. Own AI-enabled services after launch. Know the prompts, inputs, outputs, dependencies and human review steps, and build the checks that catch weak output and drift before the client does. Keep clients confident – clear on progress, honest about uncertainty and constraints — and turn what you learn in delivery into requirements Product and Engineering can act on. Lead more junior team members: give them context, standards and direct feedback, and expand their ownership as they earn it. Good decisions with incomplete information. You find the evidence that matters, weigh client impact against quality, cost and speed, and change course when the facts change. Technical enough to reason about APIs, SDKs, integrations, configuration and data without being an engineer. Practical AI fluency. You understand how an AI-enabled workflow behaves in production — prompts, inputs, failure modes, review - not just how to use a chatbot. You can direct people and hold a standard, and you know the difference between activity and results. You don't wait for a perfect brief or a meeting invite to make progress. Detail at pace. You spot missing ownership, weak evidence and work that isn't ready. Useful But Not Required Operated an AI workflow, automation or platform after launch (quality, monitoring, cost, support). Implemented SaaS or developer-facing products: APIs, SDKs, CMS, UAT, analytics. Sport, media, live events or ad-tech background. Remote startup or scale-up experience where the process didn't exist yet. What This Isn't Not a project-management role that lives in the tracker, not a relationship-only account role, and not an engineering role. Ownership doesn't end when a ticket is escalated. RECRUITMENT PROCESS Short call focused on your experience, operating judgment and use of AI. Practical (paid) take-home exercise based on a realistic product-delivery and AI-operations problem. AI use is expected; we will want to understand what you accepted, changed, checked and rejected. Interview with a team member to discuss your examples, decisions and task approach.

review_candidates.description: 🇪🇬 Up to EUR 25,000 per year, on a full time, contractor contract 🌎 Fully remote working anywhere in Egypt! ✨ Exciting high growth product, relied on by leading global brands, particularly within sports 💻 Working with the latest hardware, tech stack and tools The working hours are flexible however primarily aligning with UK working hours across weekdays. ABOUT US Storyteller is a high growth B2B SaaS platform which allows companies to integrate Stories into their owned and operated platforms. Popularized by Instagram and Snapchat, Stories are perfectly suited for boosting user engagement, audience retention, and driving advertising revenue. For customers, building their own stories experience can take years and a lot of investment however Storyteller has solved this by allowing companies to integrate in days, not years all for one monthly cost. Our end‑to‑end platform gives companies a best‑in‑class Stories experience in days with native iOS, Android, and Web SDKs, publishing tools, analytics, and ad support. We work with many globally recognised clients, particularly within sport, so if you're a sporting fan this could be a great fit! What You'll Make Happen You’ll join a fast-paced team that values ownership, clarity, and shipping. You’ll work remotely, collaborate with leading sports organisations, and be embedded in one or more products, helping shape how they use and evolve our product suite. This role sits at the intersection of AI, automation, and product ownership. There’s no central project manager - you’ll be expected to spot problems, decide what’s worth fixing, and help build the solutions. You don’t need years of product experience, but you do need curiosity, good judgement, and the willingness to get your hands dirty. What You'll Do Own AI-driven workflows and product improvements within specific parts of the product suite. Identify friction in how clients and teams use the product and propose solutions. Build and iterate on AI-powered automations, tools, and workflows to improve delivery and outcomes. Be responsible for deciding what matters within your product area, not just executing predefined tasks. You’ll translate real client and usage problems into shipped product improvements, not decks or specs. Use AI and internal tools to investigate product behaviour, debug issues, and test ideas. Work directly with engineers to ship changes and improvements. Engage with clients when needed to understand real problems and validate solutions. What We're Looking For Hands-on experience building or running AI-powered workflows, automations, or systems in a product or SaaS environment - or strong transferable experience with clear evidence you learn fast by building. Enough product judgement to decide what’s worth working on and when, balancing user needs, technical constraints, and speed. Comfort owning a problem end-to-end: from identifying the issue, to prototyping a solution, to working with developers to ship it. Genuine interest in AI beyond surface-level use - you’ve used AI to build, automate, or meaningfully change workflows, not just to brainstorm or write docs. Willingness to get into the weeds: prompts, tools, data, investigations, and iteration. Strong communication skills across technical and non-technical teams, including clients when needed. Comfortable working with data and structured information to inform decisions. High ownership mindset - you don’t wait for tickets or roadmaps to tell you what to do. Able to operate across multiple workstreams in a fast-moving environment. Reliable internet for remote work. RECRUITMENT PROCESS First, you’ll be invited for a 15-minute chat, we’ll explain the role better and answer your questions. We’ll then invite you to do a take home task (we’ll compensate you regardless of outcome) and then it’s just a final interview with the team. And that’s it!
